SELECT bbd.org_id AS orgId,
DATE_FORMAT(bb.bill_date, '%Y%m%d') AS billDate,
DATE_FORMAT(bb.privilege_date, '%Y%m%d') AS billDate,
bbd.item_type AS itemType, bbd.item_id AS itemId, bbd.executor_id AS executorId, SUM(bbd.quantity*bbd.price-bbd.discount_amount) AS receivableWorkload, SUM(bbd.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(bbd.received_amount) AS receivedWorkload, SUM(bbd.coupon_workload) AS couponWorkload FROM base_bill_detail bbd INNER JOIN base_bill bb ON bb.bill_id = bbd.bill_id
AND bb.bill_date is not null AND bbd.executor_id > 0
AND DATE_FORMAT(bb.bill_date, '%Y-%m-%d') between #{startDate} and #{endDate}
AND DATE_FORMAT(bb.privilege_date, '%Y-%m-%d') between #{startDate} and #{endDate}
GROUP BY bbd.org_id, bbd.executor_id, bbd.item_type, bbd.item_id,
DATE_FORMAT(bb.bill_date, '%Y%m%d')
DATE_FORMAT(bb.privilege_date, '%Y%m%d')
